:::{#def-ldpc-code}
#### Regular low-density parity-check code

Let $j, k \ge 1$ be [integers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-integers).
A **$(j, k)$-regular LDPC code** (low-density parity-check code) <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
consists of the words $y \in \ffield{2}^n$ with $H y = 0$,
where $H$ has $j$ ones in every column and $k$ ones in every row, and zeros elsewhere.
The rows of $H$ need not be independent. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
When no row is a sum of other rows,
$H$ is a [parity-check matrix](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-linear-code) of this [linear code](error-correcting-codes.qmd#def-linear-code).

:::
